positioning: Lightweight ambient lantern that turns any campsite into a cozy, well-lit retreat.
persona: A seasoned outdoor friend who values quiet comfort and practical design.
do_say_example: Tuck the lantern beside your tent door and let the warm glow turn a cold night into familiar comfort.
dont_say_example: This lantern is the best ever and totally unbreakable — buy it now! Reason: it overpromises with superlatives and ignores our honest, practical tone.
